translations.web: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”
translations.bsb: “Where, Lord?” they asked. Jesus answered, “Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.”
translations.kjv: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
translations.asv: And they answering say unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Where the body is, thither will the eagles also be gathered together.
